title: Spyglass: Now Available to All
summary: We are excited to announce the full availability of Spyglass, offering everyone a powerful new set of tools to achieve their goals more effectively.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: We've introduced powerful new tools that give you unparalleled control over how you manage and display all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Discover Our Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track our progress, see upcoming features, and peek at future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly upgraded checkboxes, designed to be more responsive, visually consistent, and effortlessly draggable for enhanced task management.

title: Enhanced Editor Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the editor's collaboration features, making it easier and more intuitive to work together in real time.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Discovery
summary: We've made it easier to discover and collaborate on shared ideas and projects, ensuring all relevant content is readily accessible for a more productive teamwork experience.

title: Worldwide Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to include comprehensive international language support, making our platform accessible and intuitive for users around the globe.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to make Noeko fully open source, empowering our community with greater control and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Supercharge Your Knowledge Graph
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base like never before with powerful new filtering by tags, time, and shared items in your dynamic knowledge graph.

title: Refined Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and curate your most relevant information with powerful new filtering options and the ability to save personalized collections for quick access.

title: Dynamic Note Organization
summary: Effortlessly structure your notes and deepen your understanding with new, dynamic ways to view and interact with linked content, making your workspace truly reflect your thinking.

title: Noeko Pro: Flexible Plans & On-Premise Hosting
summary: Experience Noeko's full power with new subscription tiers and the freedom to host it on your own systems, ensuring peak performance and tailored control.

title: Enhanced Themes & New Visual Options
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing exciting new options to give you more personalized and visually stunning ways to experience Noeko.

title: Smarter, Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're refining our welcome messages to accurately reflect the time of day, ensuring a more personalized and intuitive experience every time you log in.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Say goodbye to tedious navigation as you can now quickly unapply tags and delete items right from your tag views, making organization a breeze.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate insights from YouTube videos, websites, and various text formats directly into your workflow for comprehensive knowledge management.
